post.description:
Use this endpoint to search listings using various parameters.As your user provides inputs, you simply pass those inputs to this endpoint to retrieve the listings that match their preferences in real-time.

For more information refer to The Searching, Filtering and Paginating Listings Guide .

Using this endpoint you can also request market statistics, dynamic map clusters and search images using AI.

parameters.name: addressKey
parameters.description: The address key of the property. Please see the address object of a listing to understand how the address key is constructed

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: Filters listings by agent name or agent ID, for example, John Doe. Supports multiple values, for example ?agent=john&agent=mary

parameters.name: aggregates
parameters.description: Aggregates values and counts for specified fields. Aggregates have many use cases, they're particularly useful for grouping and displaying acceptable values for fields that are used in filters. More info.

parameters.name: aggregatesUnique
parameters.description: Unique aggregates values and counts for specified fields. Should be used specifically for fields containing coma-separated values. Aggregates have many use cases, they're particularly useful for grouping and displaying acceptable values for fields that are used in filters. More info.

parameters.name: aggregateStatistics
parameters.description: If true, when both "aggregates" and "statistics" parameters are used, the requested statistics will be grouped by the requested aggregates.

parameters.name: aggregatesListPriceSaleBucketSize
parameters.description: Sets the bucket size (price range width) for sale listings when "aggregates=listPrice" is used. Buckets cover the range from 0 to 5,000,000. Default is 100000.

parameters.name: aggregatesListPriceLeaseBucketSize
parameters.description: Sets the bucket size (price range width) for lease listings when "aggregates=listPrice" is used. Buckets cover the range from 0 to 10,000. Default is 500.

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more amenity values. Use the aggregates parameter to retrieve available values. Supports multiple values, for example ?amenities=Gym&amenities=Swimming Pool

parameters.name: amenitiesOperator
parameters.description: If set to "AND", listings must match all amenities values. If set to "OR", listings must match at least 1 amenities value. Default is "AND"

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: Filters listings by geographical area (also referred to as region).

parameters.name: areaOrCity
parameters.description: Filters listings where either the address.area or address.city field matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: assignment
parameters.description:
If specified, filters listings by whether they are an assignment sale. Y returns assignment listings only, N excludes them. Values are case-insensitive.

Allowed values: Y, N

parameters.name: balcony
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more values for balcony.

parameters.name: basement
parameters.description: Filters listings by basement description using the supplied value.

parameters.name: bathroomQuality
parameters.description:
Filters listings by the AI-assessed visual quality of the bathroom, derived from the listing photos. More info. Values are case-insensitive. Repeat the parameter to match any of several ratings.

Allowed values:

poor, below average, average, above average, excellent

parameters.name: bedroomQuality
parameters.description:
Filters listings by the AI-assessed visual quality of the bedroom, derived from the listing photos. More info. Values are case-insensitive. Repeat the parameter to match any of several ratings.

Allowed values:

poor, below average, average, above average, excellent

parameters.name: boardId
parameters.description: Filter by boardId. This is only required if your account has access to more than one MLS. You may specify one or more board IDs to filter by, if not specified, returns all boards that that account has access to by default. More info.

parameters.name: brokerage
parameters.description: Filters listings by brokerage name.

parameters.name: businessSubType
parameters.description: Filters commercial listings by business sub-type. Use the aggregates parameter to retrieve available values.

parameters.name: businessType
parameters.description: Filters commercial listings by business type. Use the aggregates parameter to retrieve available values.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more cities.

parameters.name: cityOrDistrict
parameters.description: Filters listings where either address.city or the address.district field matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: The class of listing to filter the search results by. Allowed values: condo, residential, commercial. For backward compatibility, the following alias values are also allowed: CondoProperty, ResidentialProperty, CommercialProperty

parameters.name: cluster
parameters.description: If true, enables dynamic map clusters. More info.

parameters.name: clusterFields
parameters.description: Specifies which listing fields to include in cluster responses. Use comma-separated values (e.g., ?clusterFields=listPrice,soldPrice). For images you can limit quantity with brackets (e.g., ?clusterFields=images[5] returns first 5 images). More info.

parameters.name: clusterLimit
parameters.description: Use this parameter to limit the amount of clusters returned when "cluster" is set to true. Values can be between 1 and 200. This parameter can only be used if "cluster" is set to true. More info.

parameters.name: clusterListingsThreshold
parameters.description: Controls the maximum cluster size for which detailed listing information is included in the response. By default, detailed listing data is only included when a cluster contains exactly 1 listing. Setting this parameter to a higher value (e.g., 5) will include a 'listings' array with full property details for any cluster containing that many or fewer listings. This reduces the need for additional API requests when users interact with small clusters. Values can be between 1 and 100. This parameter can only be used if "cluster" is set to true. More info.

parameters.name: clusterPrecision
parameters.description: Use this parameter to adjust the granularity of map clusters. A lower value aggregates listings into less clusters, a higher value aggregates listings into more clusters. Values can be between 0 and 29. This parameter can only be used if "cluster" is set to true. More info.

parameters.name: clusterStatistics
parameters.description: If true, when both "cluster" is true and the "statistics" parameter is used, the statistics will be calculated separately for each cluster. This could be useful in scenarios where understanding data on a per-cluster basis is important, such as when analyzing distinct groups or segments within your data. More info.

parameters.name: cooling
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more values for cooling. Values are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: coopCompensation
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more values for the co-operating brokerage compensation. Use aggregates=coopCompensation to retrieve available values.

parameters.name: coverImage
parameters.description: If specified, changes the cover image to the specified feature. More info.

parameters.name: den
parameters.description: Filters listings by den type. Use the aggregates parameter to retrieve available values.

parameters.name: diningRoomQuality
parameters.description:
Filters listings by the AI-assessed visual quality of the dining room, derived from the listing photos. More info. Values are case-insensitive. Repeat the parameter to match any of several ratings.

Allowed values:

poor, below average, average, above average, excellent

parameters.name: displayAddressOnInternet
parameters.description:
If not specified, returns both listings whose address may be displayed on the internet (Y) and whose address should not be displayed on the the internet (N)

Allowed values: Y, N

parameters.name: displayInternetEntireListing
parameters.description: Used to filter listings permitted for display on internet portals. "Y" indicates that the listing can be displayed, "N" indicates that it can not and may only be used for back office purposes.

parameters.name: displayPublic
parameters.description:
If not specified, returns both listings that may be displayed publicly (Y) and those that should be password protected (N)

Allowed values: Y, N

parameters.name: district
parameters.description: Filters listings by geographical district.

parameters.name: driveway
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more values for driveway.

parameters.name: exteriorConstruction
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more values for exteriorConstruction - note, matches details.exteriorConstruction1 and details.exteriorConstruction2 fields.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Use if you want to limit the response to containing certain fields only. For example: fields?listPrice,soldPrice would limit the response to contain listPrice and soldPrice only. You can also specify the amount of images to return, for example if a listing has 40 images total and you specify fields=images[5] it will only return the first 5 images. More info.

parameters.name: frontOfStructureQuality
parameters.description:
Filters listings by the AI-assessed visual quality of the front of the structure, derived from the listing photos. More info. Values are case-insensitive. Repeat the parameter to match any of several ratings.

Allowed values:

poor, below average, average, above average, excellent

parameters.name: garage
parameters.description: Filters listings by garage type. Use the aggregates parameter to retrieve available values.

parameters.name: hasAgents
parameters.description: If true, only returns listings that have a listing agent assigned to them, if false, only returns listings that do not have a listing agent assigned to them. If not specified, returns both.

parameters.name: hasImages
parameters.description: If not specified, returns both listings that have images (true) and listings that do not have images (false).

parameters.name: hasVirtualTour
parameters.description: If true, only returns listings that have a virtual tour. If false, only returns listings that do not have a virtual tour. If not specified, returns both.

parameters.name: heating
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more values for heating.

parameters.name: imagesOrder
parameters.description:
Controls the order of the images array when an image parameter (coverImage or imageSearchItems) is used. score (default) places the matched photo first. original keeps the natural MLS order, the same as a request with no image parameter. Returns a 400 error if used without coverImage or imageSearchItems.

Allowed values: score, original

parameters.name: kitchenQuality
parameters.description:
Filters listings by the AI-assessed visual quality of the kitchen, derived from the listing photos. More info. Values are case-insensitive. Repeat the parameter to match any of several ratings.

Allowed values:

poor, below average, average, above average, excellent

parameters.name: lastPriceChangeType
parameters.description: Allows you to find listings that have either increased or decreased in price.

parameters.name: lastStatus
parameters.description:
Filters the last status of the listing. Multiple values may be used, ie: lastStatus=sus&lastStatus=sld&laststatus=exp
Allowed values: Sus, Exp, Sld, Ter, Dft, Lsd, Sc, Sce, Lc, Pc, Ext, New.

For more information on lastStatus meanings refer to lastStatus Definitions

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Accepts a value for latitude. Must be used with radius parameter to return listings within a certain radius of a given latitude and longitude.

parameters.name: listDate
parameters.description: Filters listings by a specific date that the listings were added to the MLS. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: listings
parameters.description: If false, the listings object will be empty. Useful for speeding up responses when statistics and aggregates are requested and listings are not needed. Default is true.

parameters.name: livingRoomQuality
parameters.description:
Filters listings by the AI-assessed visual quality of the living room, derived from the listing photos. More info. Values are case-insensitive. Repeat the parameter to match any of several ratings.

Allowed values:

poor, below average, average, above average, excellent

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more values for locationId. For locations that have boundary data, the location boundary will be used to find listings that fall within the boundary. For locations that do not have boundary data, address components will be used to filter listings.

parameters.name: locker
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more values for locker.

parameters.name: long
parameters.description: Accepts a value for longitude. Must be used with radius parameter to return listings within a certain radius of a given latitude and longitude.

parameters.name: mapOperator
parameters.description: When a multi-polygon is provided for the "map" parameter the default condition is "OR", meaning that it will return all listings that fall inside any of the polygons. This can be changed to "AND" in which case it will return listings that fall inside all of the polygons. More info.

parameters.name: maxBaths
parameters.description: Filters listings whose total bathroom count is <= the supplied value.

parameters.name: maxBathroomsHalf
parameters.description: Filters listings whose half bathroom count is <= the supplied value.

parameters.name: maxBedrooms
parameters.description: Filters properties based on the number of bedrooms that were part of the original floorplan, typically located above grade.

parameters.name: maxBedroomsPlus
parameters.description: Filters properties based on the number of additional bedrooms added beyond the original floorplan. These bedrooms can be located in areas like basements or attics and were not part of the initial construction.

parameters.name: maxBedroomsTotal
parameters.description: Filters properties by the total number of bedrooms, combining both numBedrooms and numBedroomsPlus. This provides a comprehensive look at all spaces being used as bedrooms.

parameters.name: maxClosedDate
parameters.description: Filters listings that have a close date on or before the supplied value. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: maxCoveredSpaces
parameters.description: Filters listings whose covered parking space count is <= the supplied value. Must be greater than 0.

parameters.name: maxDaysOnMarket
parameters.description: Filters `status=U` listings that have been on the market for number of days less than or equal to the supplied value.

parameters.name: maxKitchens
parameters.description: Filters listings whose kitchen count is <= the supplied value.

parameters.name: maxListDate
parameters.description: Filters listings that were listed on or before the supplied value. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: maxLotDepth
parameters.description: Filters listings whose lot depth is <= the supplied value.

parameters.name: maxLotSizeSqft
parameters.description: Filters listings whose lot size is <= the supplied value in square feet.

parameters.name: maxLotWidth
parameters.description: Filters listings whose lot width is <= the supplied value.

parameters.name: maxMaintenanceFee
parameters.description: If supplied, filters listings whose maintenance fee is <= the supplied value.

parameters.name: maxOpenHouseDate
parameters.description: If specified, filters listings that have an open house on or before the supplied date. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: maxParkingSpaces
parameters.description: Filters listings whose parking space count is <= the supplied value.

parameters.name: maxPrice
parameters.description: Filters listings whose list price is <= the supplied value.

parameters.name: maxPriceChangeDateTime
parameters.description: Filters listings that have had a price change on or before the date specified.

parameters.name: maxQuality
parameters.description: Filters listings whose overall AI image quality score is <= the supplied value. The score is derived from the listing photos and ranges from 0 to 6. More info. Must be greater than 0 and at most 6.

parameters.name: maxRepliersUpdatedOn
parameters.description: Filters listings whose repliersUpdatedOn is the same or less than the supplied DateTime. repliersUpdatedOn is an internal timestamp, this may be useful for polling applications to identify listings that have updates in information that's exclusive of MLS updates. For example, if an estimate is recalculated since the estimate is not provided by the MLS.

parameters.name: maxSoldDate
parameters.description: Filters listings that were sold/leased on or before the supplied value. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: maxSoldPrice
parameters.description: Filters listings whose sold price is <= the supplied value.

parameters.name: maxStreetNumber
parameters.description: Filters listings whose street number is <= the supplied value.

parameters.name: maxStories
parameters.description: Filters listings whose stories are <= the supplied value.

parameters.name: maxSqft
parameters.description: Filters listings whose square footage is <= the supplied value. Excludes listings where the sqft value is not supplied by the MLS.

parameters.name: maxTaxes
parameters.description: Filters listings whose annual tax amount is equal to or less than the supplied value.

parameters.name: maxUnavailableDate
parameters.description: Filters listings that became unavailable on or before the supplied value. Not all MLSes support this parameter.

parameters.name: maxUpdatedOn
parameters.description: Filters listings that were updated on or before the supplied value.

parameters.name: maxYearBuilt
parameters.description: Filters listings whose year built value is <= the supplied value. Excludes listings where the year built value is not supplied by the MLS.

parameters.name: minBaths
parameters.description: Filters listings whose total bathroom count is >= the supplied value.

parameters.name: minBathroomsHalf
parameters.description: Filters listings whose half bathroom count is >= the supplied value.

parameters.name: minBedrooms
parameters.description: Filters properties based on the number of bedrooms that were part of the original floorplan, typically located above grade.

parameters.name: minBedroomsPlus
parameters.description: Filters properties based on the number of additional bedrooms added beyond the original floorplan. These bedrooms can be located in areas like basements or attics and were not part of the initial construction.

parameters.name: minBedroomsTotal
parameters.description: Filters properties by the total number of bedrooms, combining both numBedrooms and numBedroomsPlus. This provides a comprehensive look at all spaces being used as bedrooms.

parameters.name: minClosedDate
parameters.description: Filters listings that have a close date on or after the supplied value. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: minCoveredSpaces
parameters.description: Filters listings whose covered parking space count is >= the supplied value. Must be greater than 0.

parameters.name: minDaysOnMarket
parameters.description: Filters `status=U` listings that have been on the market for number of days greater than or equal to the supplied value.

parameters.name: minGarageSpaces
parameters.description: Filters listings that have >= the supplied value of garage spaces.

parameters.name: minKitchens
parameters.description: Filters listings whose kitchen count is >= the supplied value.

parameters.name: minListDate
parameters.description: Filters listings that were listed on or after the supplied value. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: minLotDepth
parameters.description: Filters listings whose lot depth is >= the supplied value.

parameters.name: minLotSizeSqft
parameters.description: Filters listings whose lot size is >= the supplied value in square feet.

parameters.name: minLotWidth
parameters.description: Filters listings whose lot width is >= the supplied value.

parameters.name: minOpenHouseDate
parameters.description: If specified, filters listings that have an open house on or after the supplied date. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: minParkingSpaces
parameters.description: Filters listings whose parking space count is >= the supplied value.

parameters.name: minPrice
parameters.description: Filters listings whose list price is >= the supplied value.

parameters.name: minPriceChangeDateTime
parameters.description: Filters listings that have had a price change on or after the date specified.

parameters.name: minQuality
parameters.description: Filters listings whose overall AI image quality score is >= the supplied value. The score is derived from the listing photos and ranges from 0 to 6. More info. Must be at least 0 and less than 6.

parameters.name: minRepliersUpdatedOn
parameters.description: Filters listings whose repliersUpdatedOn is the same or greater than the supplied DateTime. repliersUpdatedOn is an internal timestamp, this may be useful for polling applications to identify listings that have updates in information that's exclusive of MLS updates. For example, if an estimate is recalculated since the estimate is not provided by the MLS.

parameters.name: minSoldDate
parameters.description: Filters listings that were sold/leased on or after the supplied value. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: minSoldPrice
parameters.description: Filter listings whose sold price is >= the supplied value.

parameters.name: minStories
parameters.description: Filter listings whose stories are >= the supplied value.

parameters.name: minSqft
parameters.description: Filters listings whose square footage is >= the supplied value. Excludes listings where the sqft value is not supplied by the MLS.

parameters.name: minStreetNumber
parameters.description: Filters listings whose street number is >= the supplied value.

parameters.name: minTaxes
parameters.description: Filters listings whose annual tax amount is equal to or greater than the supplied value.

parameters.name: minUnavailableDate
parameters.description: Filters listings that became unavailable on or after the supplied value. Not all MLSes support this parameter. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: minUpdatedOn
parameters.description: Filters listings that were updated on or after the supplied value.

parameters.name: minYearBuilt
parameters.description: Filter listings whose year built value is >= the supplied value. Excludes listings where the year built value is not supplied by the MLS.

parameters.name: mlsNumber
parameters.description: Filter listings by one or more MLS numbers. To exclude a listing from the results instead, prefix its MLS number with not:, for example mlsNumber=not:C1234567. The prefix is case-insensitive, and included and excluded values may be mixed in the same request.

parameters.name: neighborhood
parameters.description: Filter by the geographical neighborhood that the listing is situated in. For example GET /listings?city=Vaughan&neighborhood=Sonoma Heights&neighborhood=Vellore Village

parameters.name: officeId
parameters.description: Filter listings by the office ID of the listing brokerage.

parameters.name: openHouseStatus
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more open house statuses (openHouse.status). Use aggregates=openHouse.status to retrieve available values.

parameters.name: openHouseType
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more open house types (openHouse.type). Use aggregates=openHouse.type to retrieve available values.

parameters.name: operator
parameters.description: If set to "AND", listings must match all supplied parameters. If set to "OR", listings must match at least 1 parameter. Default is "AND". More info.

parameters.name: overallQuality
parameters.description:
Filters listings by the AI-assessed overall visual quality of the property, derived from the listing photos. More info. Values are case-insensitive. Repeat the parameter to match any of several ratings.

Allowed values:

poor, below average, average, above average, excellent

parameters.name: pageNum
parameters.description: The page number to return. For example, with 100 results per page, specifying pageNum=2 returns results 101–200.

parameters.name: parkingType
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more values for condominium parking type (condominium.parkingType).

parameters.name: pets
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more values for the condominium pet policy (condominium.pets). Values are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: pretty
parameters.description: If true, reorders fields within each returned listing into a canonical order optimized for human readability. Does not affect which fields are returned or their values. Default is false.

parameters.name: propertyType
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more property types.

parameters.name: propertyTypeOrStyle
parameters.description: Filters listings where either details.propertyType or the details.style field matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Accepts a value for radius, expressed in the unit set by radiusUnit (KM by default). Must be used with lat and long parameters to return listings within a certain radius of a given latitude and longitude.

parameters.name: radiusUnit
parameters.description:
Sets the unit of measurement for the `radius` parameter. Can only be used together with `radius`.

Allowed values:

- `km` — kilometers (default)
- `m` — meters
- `mi` — miles
- `yd` — yards

parameters.name: resultsPerPage
parameters.description: The number of listings to return per page.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: One or more keywords may be specified to filter the results by. For more information refer to Full-Text Keyword Search Implementation Guide.

parameters.name: searchFields
parameters.description: To be used in conjunction with the "search" parameter. If specified, limits the keyword search to specific fields. For example, if search=yonge and you want to limit the search to streetName you would specify searchFields=address.streetName

parameters.name: searchOperator
parameters.description: Controls how multiple terms in the search parameter are combined. AND requires every term to match, OR requires at least one term to match. Values are case-insensitive. Default is AND.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: The attribute that the listings will be sorted by. Note, distanceAsc and distanceDesc must be used in combination with lat, long and radius parameters. Default is updatedOnDesc

parameters.name: sqft
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more values for sqft.

parameters.name: statistics
parameters.description: Use this parameter to request statistics relevant to the listings returned in your search. Multiple values may be supplied as a comma-separated list (e.g. `statistics=grp-mth,avg-listPrice,med-soldPrice`). More info.

parameters.name: standardStatus
parameters.description:
Use this parameter to filter by Standard Status.

Allowed values:

- `Active` — The listing is currently on the market and available for sale or lease. The property is being actively marketed and showings can be arranged.
- `Active Under Contract` — The listing has an accepted offer and is under contract, but remains active on the market. The seller is still accepting backup offers in case the primary contract falls through.
- `Canceled` — The listing agreement was terminated by mutual agreement between the seller and listing agent before its expiration date.
- `Closed` — The listing is no longer available. This is a general status indicating the listing process has concluded.
- `Coming Soon` — The property will be listed in the near future but is not yet officially on the market. This pre-marketing status allows agents to generate interest before the official listing date.
- `Delete` — The listing has been marked for removal from the system and should no longer appear in search results.
- `Expired` — The listing agreement period has ended without the property being sold or leased. The agreement between the seller and agent has concluded.
- `Hold` — The listing is temporarily off the market at the seller's request but has not been officially withdrawn or canceled.
- `Incomplete` — The listing has been entered into the system but does not yet have all required information for publication.
- `Pending` — The listing has an accepted offer and is under contract, progressing toward closing. The property is no longer being actively marketed and showings are typically not permitted.
- `Withdrawn` — The seller has temporarily removed the property from the market, typically with the intent to re-list later.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Set `status=A` to retrieve active listings. Set `status=U` to retrieve unavailable listings. Set `status=A&status=U` to retrieve both active and unavailable listings.

parameters.name: streetDirection
parameters.description: Filter listings by one or more street directions

parameters.name: streetName
parameters.description: Filter by the street name of the listing (excluding the street suffix and direction, for example "Yonge")

parameters.name: streetNumber
parameters.description: Filter by the street number of the listing.

parameters.name: streetSuffix
parameters.description: Filter listings by one or more street suffixes

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Filter by the property style of the listing.

parameters.name: swimmingPool
parameters.description: Filter listings by one of more values for swimmingPool.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Used to filter properties that are for sale or for lease. If not specified, will return listings of all types.

Allowed values:

sale, lease

parameters.name: unitNumber
parameters.description: Filter by one or more unit numbers.

parameters.name: updatedOn
parameters.description: Filter listings by a specific date that the listings were last updated on the MLS. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: waterSource
parameters.description: Filter listings by one or more values for waterSource.

parameters.name: repliersUpdatedOn
parameters.description: Filters listings whose repliersUpdatedOn is a specific date. repliersUpdatedOn is an internal timestamp, this may be useful for polling applications to identify listings that have updates in information that's exclusive of MLS updates. For example, if an estimate is recalculated since the estimate is not provided by the MLS.

parameters.name: sewer
parameters.description: Filters listings by one or more values for sewer.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filter by the address state of the listing, for example "NY"

parameters.name: waterfront
parameters.description: If not specified, returns both listings that are waterfront and those that are not. If "Y", returns listings that are waterfront, if "N" returns listings that are not waterfront or unspecified.

parameters.name: yearBuilt
parameters.description: Filter listings by one or more values for yearBuilt.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: Filters listings by postal or zip code.

parameters.name: zoning
parameters.description: Filter listings by zoning description.

requestBody.description: Filters may be supplied in the request body as an alternative to the query string, which is useful for large values such as map polygons or long lists of mlsNumbers. When the same filter is supplied in both the query string and the body, the query string value takes precedence.

imageSearchItems.description: An array of objects used with our AI Image Search feature. For more information refer to our AI Image Search Implementation Guide.

type.description: Indicates if the imageSearchItem is an image input or a text input. Values are case-sensitive and must be lowercase.

url.description: The url of the image. Required, and must be a valid URI, when type=image. Ignored otherwise.

value.description: The value of the text. Required when type=text. Ignored otherwise. Example: White Kitchen

boost.description: A value indicating the importance of the imageSearchItem. The greater the value, the more important it is in comparison with other imageSearchItems. May be used when multiple imageSearchItems are provided in a single request.

cities.description: Body equivalent of the city query parameter. Filters listings by one or more cities. Note the plural spelling; the request body does not accept city.

neighborhoods.description: Body equivalent of the neighborhood query parameter. Filters listings by one or more neighborhoods. Note the plural spelling; the request body does not accept neighborhood.

areaOrCity.description: Body equivalent of the areaOrCity query parameter. Filters listings where either the address.area or address.city field matches any of the provided values.

cityOrDistrict.description: Body equivalent of the cityOrDistrict query parameter. Filters listings where either the address.city or address.district field matches any of the provided values.

mlsNumber.description: Body equivalent of the mlsNumber query parameter. Filters listings by one or more mlsNumbers. To exclude a listing from the results instead, prefix its MLS number with not:, for example ["not:C1234567"]. The prefix is case-insensitive, and included and excluded values may be mixed in the same array. Unlike the query form, the body form must be an array containing at least one value.

listings.description: Restricts the results to exactly the listings supplied. Each item identifies one listing by its mlsNumber and, when your API key has access to more than one board, by its boardId. An item without an mlsNumber, or with a boardId your API key cannot access, is rejected with a 400 error. This parameter only includes listings; it does not support the not: prefix. To exclude listings from the results, use mlsNumber with the not: prefix instead. This is unrelated to the boolean listings query parameter.

boardId.description: The boardId the listing belongs to. Required when your API key has access to more than one board.

get.description:
Use this endpoint to get details about a specific listing.

When requesting a specific listing an expanded view of the listing is provided which includes comparables as well as the MLS history for the specific property. This is useful for building single property views within your app or website.

parameters.name: boardId
parameters.description: Filter by boardId. This is only required if your account has access to more than one MLS.

parameters.name: mlsNumber
parameters.description: The MLS number of the listing you wish to retrieve.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: If set to `raw`, returns raw fields the way data fields come from MLS.

parameters.name: locations
parameters.description: If set to `true`, fetches locations whose boundary contains this listing's coordinates. Under the hood uses [GET /locations](/reference/get_locations) with `pointWithinBoundary=true`.

parameters.name: locationsSource
parameters.description:
Filters the locations returned by `locations=true` by source:
- `MLS` - Locations sourced from MLS (Multiple Listing Service) data.
- `UserDefined` - Custom locations created and defined by users.
- `LiveBy` - Locations sourced from LiveBy, a third-party neighborhood and community data provider.
- `PublicRecord` - Locations sourced from Public Records Data.

parameters.name: locationsType
parameters.description: Filters the locations returned by `locations=true` by type. Same values as the `type` parameter of [GET /locations](/reference/get_locations).

get.description:
Provide this endpoint with an mls number and it'll retrieve similar properties that are also for sale.

This is really useful if you'd like to show your users other properties they may be interested in.

By default this endpoint will retrieve similar properties in the same neighborhood, however you can override this by using a radius parameter.

parameters.name: mlsNumber
parameters.description: The MLS number of the listing you wish to retrieve similar listings for.

parameters.name: boardId
parameters.description: Filter by boardId. This is only required if your account has access to more than one MLS. More info.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Use if you want to limit the response to containing certain fields only. For example: `fields=listPrice,soldPrice` would limit the response to contain `listPrice` and `soldPrice` only. You can also specify the amount of images to return, for example if a listing has 40 images total and you specify `fields=images[5]` it will only return the first 5 images.

parameters.name: listPriceRange
parameters.description: If specified, returns similar listings whose listPrice are +/- the supplied value, for a given listing. For example, if the given listing is 1M and listPriceRange is 250k, similar listings between 750k and 1.25M will be returned.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: If specified, will show similar listings within the specified radius, expressed in the unit set by radiusUnit (KM by default). If not specified, defaults to showing listings in the same neighborhood.

parameters.name: radiusUnit
parameters.description:
Sets the unit of measurement for the `radius` parameter. Can only be used together with `radius`.

Allowed values:

- `km` — kilometers (default)
- `m` — meters
- `mi` — miles
- `yd` — yards

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description:
Allowed values:

updatedOnDesc,updatedOnAsc,createdOnAsc,createdOnDesc

similar.description: The similar listings. Confirmed against a live response to have the same shape as GET /listings/{mlsNumber} (address, details, lot, nearby, office, openHouse, rooms, taxes, timestamps, agents, condominium, permissions, images, etc. — see that endpoint for the full nested shape), plus the additional fields below.

get.description:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the MLS history of a specific address.

In addition to displaying the history you could also use the information in the response to create a graph that illustrates the change in value over time.

You must identify the property in one of the following ways:

- supply `mlsNumber`, or
- supply `addressKey`, or
- supply `streetName` together with `streetNumber` and either `city` or `zip`.

The remaining address parameters (`unitNumber`, `streetSuffix`, `streetDirection`) are always optional and can be used to narrow the match.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: The city of the property. Required when searching by `streetName`, unless a `zip` is provided.

parameters.name: streetName
parameters.description: The street name of the property. Required unless `mlsNumber` or `addressKey` is provided.

parameters.name: streetNumber
parameters.description: The street number of the property. Required when searching by `streetName`.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: The zip code or postal code of the property. Supports partial match, for example if supplied value is "123" it will match "12345". Required when searching by `streetName`, unless a `city` is provided.

parameters.name: mlsNumber
parameters.description: If specified, will return the history for the property that can be identified by the given MLS number

parameters.name: addressKey
parameters.description: The address key of the property. Please see the address object of a listing to understand how the address key is constructed

parameters.name: pretty
parameters.description: If true, reorders fields within each returned listing into a canonical order optimized for human readability. Does not affect which fields are returned or their values. Default is false.

schema.description: Address history for the matched property (echoes the address components, plus a history of listings recorded at that address).

history.description: The listings recorded at this address, most recent first.

listingUpdated.description: The date/time the listing was deleted/last updated.

get.description: Searches for geographical locations such as cities, neighborhoods, and districts. Useful for building location pickers and populating address-based filters in search interfaces. For real-time autocomplete as a user types, use the GET /locations/autocomplete endpoint instead.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description:
Filters locations by source:
- `MLS` - Locations sourced from MLS (Multiple Listing Service) data.
- `UserDefined` - Custom locations created and defined by users.
- `LiveBy` - Locations sourced from LiveBy, a third-party neighborhood and community data provider.
- `PublicRecord` - Locations sourced from Public Records Data.

`UserDefined`, `LiveBy` and `PublicRecord` require the corresponding data to be enabled on your account. Requesting a source that is not enabled for your account returns a 400 error.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Limits results to specified location types:
- `area` - Represents larger geographical divisions that may contain multiple cities and neighborhoods. Examples of Areas are counties, regions etc.
- `city` - Municipal division that can include multiple neighborhoods within its boundaries.
- `city-alternate` - Alternate representation of a city, used for specific data sources or contexts.
- `neighborhood` - Smallest geographical unit within a city.
- `neighborhood-alternate` - Alternate representation of a neighborhood, used for specific data sources or contexts.
- `postalCode` - Represents postal code areas, which may span multiple neighborhoods or cities.
- `district` - Represents administrative or political districts, which may span multiple neighborhoods or cities.
- `schoolDistrict` - Represents school district areas, which may span multiple neighborhoods or cities.
- `school` - Represents specific school locations and catchment areas.
- `property` - Represents individual properties or land parcels along with publicly available information derived from public records data.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filters locations by 2-letter State/Province/Territory codes. Returns locations within the specified states.

parameters.name: area
parameters.description:
Filters locations by area names. Returns locations within the specified area.
Areas represent larger geographical divisions that may contain multiple cities and neighborhoods. Examples of Areas are counties, regions etc.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description:
Filters locations by city names. Returns locations within the specified city.
Cities can include multiple neighborhoods within their boundaries.

parameters.name: neighborhood
parameters.description:
Filter results by neighborhood names. Returns specified neighborhoods.
Neighborhoods represent the smallest geographical division in the hierarchy.

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: Filters by location IDs. Location IDs can be obtained from response of [Locations Autocomplete](/reference/get_locations-autocomplete#/) endpoint

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.
This allows clients to request only the specific data they need, reducing payload size.
Examples:
- `name,type` - Returns only location names and types
- `name,address.city,address.state` - Returns location names and specific address components
- `map.boundary` - Returns only geographical boundary data

parameters.name: locations
parameters.description: If false, the locations object will be empty. Useful for speeding up responses when aggregates are requested and locations are not needed. Default is true.

parameters.name: aggregates
parameters.description:
Aggregates values and counts for specified fields. Aggregates have many use cases, they're particularly useful for grouping and displaying acceptable values for fields that are used in filters. For more information refer to Using Aggregates To Determine Acceptable Values For Filters.

Comma-separate multiple fields. Only the following fields may be aggregated; any other value is rejected with a 400 error:

type, subType, classification, source, address.state, address.area, address.city, address.neighborhood, school.districtName, school.schoolType, school.lowGrade, school.highGrade, school.schoolLevel, school.isCharterSchool, school.isMagnetSchool, school.isVirtualSchool, school.isPrivate, school.isJJFacility, school.privateSchoolAffiliation, school.giftedAndTalented, school.dualEnrollment, school.creditRecovery, school.singleSexClasses, school.apCourse, school.internationalBaccalaureate, school.corporalPunishment, school.interscholarAthletics, school.offersKindergarten, school.offersFullDayKindergarten, school.apEnrollment, school.expenditurePerStudent, school.isTitleISchool, school.isTitleISchoolwideSchool, school.privateHours, school.privateDays, school.privateHasLibrary, school.privateCoed, school.isAssigned

parameters.name: resultsPerPage
parameters.description: The number of locations to return per page. Values above 300 (or above the limit configured for your account) are not rejected; they are capped to that limit.

parameters.name: pageNum
parameters.description: The page number to return. For example, with 100 results per page, specifying pageNum=2 returns results 101–200. Paging is limited to the first 100,000 results, so pageNum multiplied by resultsPerPage must not exceed 100,000. A pageNum more than one page past the last page of results is rejected with a 400 error.

parameters.name: map
parameters.description:
GeoJSON polygon or multi-polygon boundary for geographical filtering. Limits results to locations within the specified boundaries.
For complex polygons or multipolygons that exceed query parameter size limits, use the POST method

get.description: Use this endpoint to retrieve relevant schools, parks, transit stops and safety places for a given latitude and longitude. This endpoint is useful to enrich property and neighborhood views with local places information.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: The latitude of the point that you'd like to retrieve places data for.

parameters.name: long
parameters.description: The longitude of the point that you'd like to retrieve places data for.

parameters.name: inputInsidePolygon
parameters.description: Filters places by whether the specified lat/long falls inside their boundary polygon. Every returned place that has a boundary polygon always includes an `inputInsidePolygon` field with this result, regardless of this parameter. When set to `true`, only places whose polygon contains the point are returned. When set to `false`, only places whose polygon does not contain the point are returned. Places without a boundary polygon are always returned and do not include the field.

score.description: A school quality/rating score, if available. Exact scale unconfirmed.

allOf.description: Fields common to every place category (schools, parks, transit_stops, safety_places).

id.description: The unique identifier of this place.

url.description: A URL with more information about this place, if available.

features.description: A dynamic map of category-specific attributes (e.g. contact info, classification codes). Keys and value types vary by place and category, so they aren't individually enumerated here.

place_type.description: The category of place (e.g. school, park, transit_stop, safety_place).

distance.description: The distance from the queried lat/long to this place.

point.description: The lat/long coordinates of this place.

geometry.description: A GeoJSON boundary polygon for this place, if one exists.

major_park.description: Whether this is classified as a major park.

type.description: The type of transit stop (e.g. bus, subway).

post.description:

post.description:
Use this endpoint to create a saved search for a client.

Important - the filters must be specific enough so that the initial matches do not exceed 100 listings (the default, which may be configured per account), otherwise a 406 (not accepted) response will be received. A client may have at most 5 saved searches by default (also configurable per account); exceeding that limit returns a 406.

Validation rules

clientId must belong to your account, and agentId (if supplied) must be an agent in your account that the client is assigned to.
cities and areas must match values that exist on listings in your MLS data (case-insensitive).
propertyTypes and styles must be values returned by GET /listings?listings=false&aggregates=details.propertyType,details.style.
For every min/max pair (price, beds, baths, sqft, yearBuilt, stories, coveredSpaces, lotSizeSqft, lotWidth) the minimum cannot be greater than the maximum.
map polygons must contain at least 3 distinct coordinates.

clientId.description: The clientId of the client that the search is for. This client will receive notifications from the agent that's assigned to them when listings that match the saved search criteria are listed.

name.description: You can specify a name for the saved search. This is useful in cases where users have multiple saved searches, to help them distinguish between saved searches. Maximum 50 characters.

areas.description: An array of areas to be used as a filter for this search. Required, together with cities, if neither map nor locationIds is provided.

basement.description: If specified, matches only listings whose basement description match all of the supplied values. For a list of supported values, make a GET /listings?listings=false&aggregates=details.basement1,details.basement2 request.

cities.description: An array of cities to be used as a filter for this search. Required, together with areas, if neither map nor locationIds is provided.

class.description:
Indicates what class of property to search for.

Allowed values:

residential,condo,commercial

heating.description: An array of heating values to be used as a filter for this search.

neighborhoods.description: An array of neighborhoods to be used as a filter for this search. Optional. Does not replace the areas and cities requirement when map is not provided.

notificationFrequency.description:
Sets the frequency that clients will be notified of listings that match their search criteria.

Allowed values:

instant, daily, weekly, monthly

map.description: An array of polygons arrays with arrays of longitude/latitude shapes to be used as a filter for this search. If used, only listings that area geographically located within these shapes will be matched. Required if neither locationIds nor both areas and cities are provided.

maxBaths.description: The maximum amount of bathrooms to be used as a filter for this search.

maxBeds.description: The maximum amount of bedrooms to be used as a filter for this search.

maxCoveredSpaces.description: The maximum amount of covered spaces to be used as a filter for this search.

minParkingSpaces.description: If specified, matches only listings whose parking space count is >= the supplied value.

maxPrice.description: The maximum list price to be used as a filter for this search.

minBaths.description: The minimum amount of bathrooms to be used as a filter for this search.

minBeds.description: The minimum amount of bedrooms to be used as a filter for this search.

minCoveredSpaces.description: The minimum amount of covered spaces to be used as a filter for this search.

minGarageSpaces.description: If specified, matches only listings whose garage space count is >= the supplied value.

minKitchens.description: If specified, matches only listings whose kitchen count is >= the supplied value.

maxMaintenanceFee.description: If supplied limits matches to listings where the maintenance fee is <= the supplied value.

minPrice.description: The minimum list price to be used as a filter for this search.

pets.description: An array of pet policy values to be used as a filter for this search.

priceChangeNotifications.description: If set to true, clients will receive price change notifications for listings that have been matched for them.

propertyTypes.description: An array of property types to be used as a filter for this search.

sewer.description: An array of sewer values to be used as a filter for this search.

status.description: If set to false, disables this search.

soldNotifications.description: If set to true, clients will receive sold notifications for listings that have been matched for them.

streetNames.description: An array of street names to be used as a filter for this search.

streetNumbers.description: An array of street numbers to be used as a filter for this search.

styles.description: An array of property styles to be used as a filter for this search.

swimmingPool.description: An array of swimming pool values to be used as a filter for this search.

type.description:
Indicates whether the search is for a property that's for sale or for lease.

Allowed values:

sale,lease

waterSource.description: An array of water source values to be used as a filter for this search.

minLotSizeSqft.description: The minimum lot size in square feet to be used as a filter for this search.

maxLotSizeSqft.description: The maximum lot size in square feet to be used as a filter for this search.

minLotWidth.description: The minimum lot width to be used as a filter for this search. If specified, matches only listings whose lot width is >= the supplied value. Must be greater than 0 and cannot be greater than maxLotWidth. The unit of measurement is the same as the one the MLS board provides in its data.

maxLotWidth.description: The maximum lot width to be used as a filter for this search. If specified, matches only listings whose lot width is <= the supplied value. Must be greater than 0 and cannot be less than minLotWidth. The unit of measurement is the same as the one the MLS board provides in its data.

minOpenHouseDate.description: Indicates whether the search is for properties that have an Open House on or after the supplied date. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD

maxOpenHouseDate.description: Indicates whether the search is for properties that have an Open House on or before the supplied date. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD. It's not recommended to use it unless you have a very good reason to set it.

standardStatus.description:
Indicates what Standard Status of property to search for.

Allowed values:

Active, Active Under Contract, Closed, Expired, Pending, Canceled, Incomplete

fields.description:
An object of raw MLS field filters to be used for this search. Each key is a raw field name and each value is an array of possible values for that field. Raw field names must be prefixed with raw., for example raw.Room13level or raw.PropertyUse. Supports up to 50 fields and up to 50 values per field.

Example: {"raw.Room13level": ["Main"]}

locationIds.description: An array of locationIds (see GET /locations) to be used as a filter for this search. If provided, map, areas and cities are not required. Values must be alphanumeric. Duplicates are removed.

agentId.description: The agentId of the agent that the search is assigned to. Must be an agent in your account that the client is assigned to. If not specified, defaults to the agent assigned to the client.

get.description: Returns a list of saved searches. Use this to display a client's active searches, or to audit searches across multiple agents.

patch.description: Use this endpoint to update a saved search. Important - When a saved search is updated the filters must be specific enough so that the initial matches do not exceed 100 listings (the default, which may be configured per account) otherwise a 406 (not accepted) response will be received. Validation rules - the same rules as POST /searches apply, and min/max range checks are evaluated against the stored values as well as the supplied ones. For example, sending only a minPrice that is greater than the stored maxPrice returns a 400 error. Supplied areas, cities and map values are combined with the stored search; a search cannot be updated so that it ends up with neither a map nor both areas and cities, unless it has locationIds.

clientId.description: The clientId of the client that the search is for. This client will receive notifications from the agent that's assigned to them when listings that match the saved search criteria are listed.

name.description: You can specify a name for the saved search. This is useful in cases where users have multiple saved searches, to help them distinguish between saved searches. Maximum 50 characters.

areas.description: An array of areas to be used as a filter for this search. Required, together with cities, if neither map nor locationIds is provided.

cities.description: An array of cities to be used as a filter for this search. Required, together with areas, if neither map nor locationIds is provided.

class.description:

heating.description: An array of heating values to be used as a filter for this search.

notificationFrequency.description:

instant, daily, weekly, monthly

map.description: An array of polygons arrays with arrays of longitude/latitude shapes to be used as a filter for this search. If used, only listings that area geographically located within these shapes will be matched. Required if neither locationIds nor both areas and cities are provided.

maxBaths.description: The maximum amount of bathrooms to be used as a filter for this search.

maxBeds.description: The maximum amount of bedrooms to be used as a filter for this search.

minParkingSpaces.description: If specified, matches only listings whose parking space count is >= the supplied value.

maxPrice.description: The maximum list price to be used as a filter for this search.

minPrice.description: The minimum list price to be used as a filter for this search.

pets.description: An array of pet policy values to be used as a filter for this search.

priceChangeNotifications.description: If set to true, clients will receive price change notifications for listings that have been matched for them.

maxLotWidth.description: The maximum lot width to be used as a filter for this search. If specified, matches only listings whose lot width is <= the supplied value. Must be greater than 0 and cannot be less than minLotWidth. The unit of measurement is the same as the one the MLS board provides in its data.

minOpenHouseDate.description: Indicates whether the search is for properties that have an Open House on or after the supplied date. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD

maxOpenHouseDate.description: Indicates whether the search is for properties that have an Open House on or before the supplied date. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD. It's not recommended to use it unless you have a very good reason to set it.

standardStatus.description:

Active, Active Under Contract, Closed, Expired, Pending, Canceled, Incomplete

fields.description:
An object of raw MLS field filters to be used for this search. Each key is a raw field name and each value is an array of possible values for that field. Raw field names must be prefixed with raw., for example raw.Room13level or raw.PropertyUse. Supports up to 50 fields and up to 50 values per field.

Only the fields supplied are updated. The values supplied for a field replace its existing values, and fields that are not supplied are left unchanged. Set a field to null to remove it, or set fields to null to remove all raw field filters.

post.description:
Use this endpoint to estimate a property's value by providing us with the property's attributes. More info.

Important - the estimates feature must be enabled on your account; every /estimates endpoint returns a 403 error otherwise.

Validation rules

Only one estimate may be stored per client and address; creating a second one for the same clientId and address returns a 400 error.
details.propertyType, details.style, details.basement1 and details.basement2 must be values that exist in your MLS data (see GET /listings?listings=false&aggregates=details.propertyType,details.style,details.basement1,details.basement2).
details.yearBuilt must be a valid year or a value that exists in your MLS data.
details.sqft must be numeric.
No value in the request body may contain a newline character.

overallQuality.description: An indication of the overall renovation quality of the property. You may use a numeric value between 1.0 and 6.0 or one of these strings: poor, below average, average, above average, excellent. If not specified, defaults to average.

propertyType.description: Must be a property type value that exists in your MLS data. For a list of supported values, make a GET /listings?listings=false&aggregates=details.propertyType request.

sqft.description: The square footage of the property. Must be numeric.

style.description: Must be a style value that exists in your MLS data. For a list of supported values, make a GET /listings?listings=false&aggregates=details.style request.

yearBuilt.description: Must be a valid year, or a year-built value that exists in your MLS data.

numFireplaces.description: The number of fireplaces. The strings "y" and "n" are also accepted and mapped to 1 and 0.

extras.description: Additional property features. Accepts an array of strings or a single string.

sendEmailNow.description: If set to true and there's a clientId specified, the client will receive a message immediately with a link that will allow them to access their estimate. Note - your account must have the Repliers messaging addon to use this feature.

sendEmailMonthly.description: If set to true and there's a clientId specified, the client will receive a message on a monthly basis with a link to a current estimate.  Note - your account must have the Repliers messaging addon to use this feature.

clientId.description: Set this to the clientId that the estimate is for if you wish to store the estimate. If sendEmailNow or sendEmailMonthly is used, messages containing estimates will be sent to this clientId. Required when sendEmailNow or sendEmailMonthly is true.

boardId.description: Required when using an API key that has access to multiple boards, unless resource is supplied. A boardId that your API key does not have access to is rejected with a 400 error.

resource.description: The MLS resource identifier of the board, as an alternative to boardId. Must be a resource that your API key has access to.

listDate.description: The date the property was listed, if known. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ

post.description:
Use this endpoint to send a message.

A message is either sent from an agent to a client, or from a client to an agent.

Messages can be used to facilitate communication between agents and their clients for marketing automation or general communication.

Text messaging and email is supported.

agent,client

post.description:
Use this endpoint to subscribe to a webhook.

Verification handshake - when a subscription is created, the API sends a POST request to the target_url with an X-Hook-Secret header. Your endpoint must respond with the same X-Hook-Secret header and value. If the secret is not echoed back the request fails with a 401 error, and if the target_url cannot be reached it fails with a 400 error.

A target_url that is already used by another subscription is rejected with a 409 error. Sandbox API keys cannot create subscriptions and receive a 403 error.

configuration.description: Configuration options for the webhook. Unknown properties are rejected with a 400 error.

filters.description: Only deliver events whose payload matches all of the supplied filters.

field.description: The payload field to filter on.

logic.description: The comparison to apply. Defaults to an exact match when omitted.

filters.description: Only deliver events whose payload matches all of the supplied filters.

post.description: This endpoint translates natural language search queries into structured API requests for the Repliers listings endpoint. For example, the prompt `find me properties in new york`` would be converted to the equivalent API call: https://api.repliers.io/listings?city=New York

parameters.name: nlpVersion
parameters.description: NLP Model version

prompt.description: The natural language prompt to be processed.
prompt.example: Find me a condo in toronto with at least 1 bedroom in the annex. It must have underground parking.

nlpId.description:
Unique identifier for maintaining context-aware interactions across multiple prompts.

- **If omitted or blank:** A new session is created, and the system processes the prompt independently without any prior context.
- **If provided:** The prompt is added to the existing session associated with the given `nlpId`, allowing the system to consider the conversation history when generating the API request.

When you send a prompt to the `/nlp` endpoint, the system returns an `nlpId` in the response. You can include this `nlpId` in subsequent requests to build upon previous interactions and maintain continuity within the same conversation thread.

clientId.description: The `clientId` of the client that the NLP prompt is for. Must be an existing client in your account, otherwise a 404 error is returned.

listings.description: If `true`, the endpoint will return listings according to the generated urlQueryString parameters, the same way as GET /lisitngs endpoint would treat those parameters. Default is `false`.

boardId.description:
Restricts the prompt to a single board. Only relevant for API keys with access to multiple boards.

The NLP model uses the acceptable values (aggregates) of the boards available to your API key when translating a prompt. On a multi-board key, values from several boards are combined, which can result in a generated query that uses a value belonging to a different board. Supplying `boardId` narrows the model to that one board, so the values it produces are always valid for it.

If the supplied `boardId` is not accessible with your API key, a `403` response is returned.

fields.description: Use if you want to limit the `listings` response object to containing certain fields only. For example: `fields=listPrice,soldPrice` would limit the response to contain `listPrice` and `soldPrice` only. You can also specify the amount of images to return, for example if a listing has 40 images total and you specify `fields=images[5]` it will only return the first 5 images.

useLocationId.description: When set to `true`, any locations identified in the prompt will be returned as `locationId` values instead of being split into separate `area`, `city`, and `neighborhood` parameters.

locationsSource.description:
Specify which location sources to use when interpreting the prompt. This can help improve accuracy by providing the NLP model with the location data source most suitable for the query.
- `MLS` - Locations sourced from MLS (Multiple Listing Service) data.
- `UserDefined` - Custom locations created and defined by users.
- `LiveBy` - Locations sourced from LiveBy, a third-party neighborhood and community data provider.
- `PublicRecord` - Locations sourced from Public Records Data.

nlpId.description: Unique session identifier for maintaining context in future NLP requests.

nlpVersion.description: The NLP model version used to process the prompt.

clientId.description: The `clientId` of the client that the NLP prompt is for.

request.description: Details of the Repliers API request generated by the NLP model.

url.description: Formatted GET /listings URL ready for use.

body.description: Formatted POST /listings body ready for use.

value.description: The text or image URL for the search item.

boost.description: Boost value for the search item.

summary.description: Summary of how the prompt was interpreted by NLP model.
summary.example: Searching for a condominium apartment in Toronto with a minimum of 1 bedroom located in the Annex neighborhood. The property must have underground parking.

locations.description: List of locations identified in the prompt.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the location

size.description: Size of the location in square kilometers

point.description: A WKT point representation of the coordinates, e.g. "POINT (-79.49 43.98)".

geometryType.description: The type of the boundary geometry (e.g. Polygon, MultiPolygon), if a boundary is present.

403.description:
Forbidden - returned when either:

- your account does not have access to the NLP feature, or
- the supplied `boardId` is not accessible with your API key.

404.description: Not Found - the supplied `clientId` does not exist in your account, or the supplied `nlpId` does not match an existing session.

406.description: Not accepted - If the input is not relevant to a listings search a 406 response will be returned. For example, "why is the sky blue" would return a 406 response.

500.description: Internal Server Error - An error occurred while processing the request.

post.description: Searches for buildings based on location, price, property type, and other criteria. A building represents a unique address and groups together all current and historical listings at that address, making it useful for building directory pages and pre-construction research.

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: Filters buildings by geographical area (also referred to as region or county).

parameters.name: buildingName
parameters.description: Filters buildings by name. Availability of building names may vary by MLS and is not guaranteed for all buildings.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Filters buildings by city.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: Filters buildings by property class.

parameters.name: displayPublic
parameters.description: Filters buildings by public display status. Y returns buildings that may be displayed publicly, N returns buildings that should be password protected. Note - this parameter is currently validated but has no effect on the results.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Accepts a value for latitude. Must be used together with the long and radius parameters to return buildings within a certain radius of a given latitude and longitude. If any one of lat, long or radius is provided, all three are required.

parameters.name: long
parameters.description: Accepts a value for longitude. Must be used together with the lat and radius parameters to return buildings within a certain radius of a given latitude and longitude. If any one of lat, long or radius is provided, all three are required.

parameters.name: map
parameters.description: GeoJSON polygon or multi-polygon boundary for geographical filtering. Limits results to buildings within the specified boundaries. For complex polygons or multipolygons that exceed query parameter size limits, use the POST method and include the map data in the request body. Format: Array of coordinate arrays, where each coordinate is [longitude, latitude] in WGS 84 format. The polygon must be closed (first and last points must be identical). For more information refer to the implementation guide Filtering Listings Geo-Spatially Using the "map" Parameter

parameters.name: maxPrice
parameters.description: Filters buildings whose listing prices are <= the supplied value.

parameters.name: maxStories
parameters.description: Filters buildings whose story count is <= the supplied value.

parameters.name: minBathrooms
parameters.description: Filters buildings whose bathroom count is >= the supplied value.

parameters.name: minBedrooms
parameters.description: Filters buildings whose bedroom count is >= the supplied value.

parameters.name: minPrice
parameters.description: Filters buildings whose listing prices are >= the supplied value.

parameters.name: minStories
parameters.description: Filters buildings whose story count is >= the supplied value.

parameters.name: neighborhood
parameters.description: Filters buildings by neighborhood.

parameters.name: pageNum
parameters.description: The page number to return. For example, with 100 results per page, specifying pageNum=2 returns results 101–200.

parameters.name: propertyType
parameters.description: Filters buildings by property type.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Accepts a value for radius, expressed in the unit set by `radiusUnit` (KM by default). Must be used with `lat` and `long` parameters to return buildings within the specified radius of a given latitude and longitude. If any one of lat, long or radius is provided, all three are required. Must be a whole number greater than 0.

parameters.name: radiusUnit
parameters.description:
Sets the unit of measurement for the `radius` parameter. Can only be used together with `radius`.

Allowed values:

- `km` — kilometers (default)
- `m` — meters
- `mi` — miles
- `yd` — yards

parameters.name: resultsPerPage
parameters.description: The number of buildings to return per page.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sorts results by the specified field. Note - this parameter is currently validated but has no effect on the order of the results.

parameters.name: streetName
parameters.description: Filters buildings by street name.

parameters.name: streetNumber
parameters.description: Filters buildings by street number.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filters buildings by listing type.

schema.description: Whether the property is for sale or lease

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filters buildings by the status of their listings. A returns buildings with available listings, U returns buildings with unavailable listings. Values are case-insensitive. Repeat the parameter to supply both.

requestBody.description:
Optional request body for complex geographical filtering using GeoJSON polygons.
Use this for large polygon data that exceeds query parameter size limits.

200.description: Successful response containing list of buildings

buildings.description: Array of building objects matching the search criteria
